## Датабанк — Company.id 4475

Catalog metadata (unchanged):

```json
  "title": "\u0414\u0430\u0442\u0430\u0431\u0430\u043d\u043a",

```

Frozen base commit: `fe29fbc1291b8842ed201261408a3bc690875b55`. Checked: `2026-10-02T18:06:28.211910Z`.

- Generated VectorDrawable XML: [final.xml](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/1dc8665bd3ad900f439d23e2cac61610fc36318b/review-materials/4475/final.xml) — SHA-256 `c338b10a3b695bbcd0dcf4aa2ebee7eaa7074cc3bef89e5ec63b720116561ac4`.
- Exact base-to-final changes: [candidate.diff](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/1dc8665bd3ad900f439d23e2cac61610fc36318b/review-materials/4475/candidate.diff).

### Evidence and judgment

- official checked 2026-10-02T17:50:04Z: [https://izhcombank.ru/](https://izhcombank.ru/). Official site unreachable: HTTPS transfer failed \(connection error\), consistent with the bank's closure \(license revoked 2019\). (independence group: official-site).
- official checked 2026-10-02T17:50:14Z: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200101185509id\_/https://www.izhcombank.ru/](https://web.archive.org/web/20200101185509id_/https://www.izhcombank.ru/). Archived homepage \(2020-01-01\): header logo is an inline SVG \(viewBox 0 0 207.98 48, colors #004790/#7c7d7d/#9e9fa0\) combining the mark with the wordmark; no standalone \<img\> logo file referenced. source-material extraction blocked: external SVG style context / duplicate vector IDs. (independence group: official-site-archived).
- official checked 2026-10-02T17:51:46Z: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200806122122id\_/https://izhcombank.ru/about/rebrending/](https://web.archive.org/web/20200806122122id_/https://izhcombank.ru/about/rebrending/). Official rebranding page \(archived 2020-08-06\): announces ПАО «Ижкомбанк» rebranding to «Датабанк», confirming the record's title/brand period. (independence group: official-site-archived).
- official checked 2026-10-02T17:52:25Z: [https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=izhcombank.ru/images/\*](https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=izhcombank.ru/images/*). Official full logo SVG \(250x55, grey #CCCCCC monochrome variant\): circular И-swoosh mark + «ижкомбанк» wordmark. Original vector, but contains accompanying lettering; not suitable as a standalone catalog mark. (independence group: official-site-archived).
- official checked 2026-10-02T17:52:46Z: [https://izhcombank.ru/images/logo-general.svg](https://izhcombank.ru/images/logo-general.svg); asset [https://web.archive.org/web/2020id\_/https://izhcombank.ru/images/logo-general.svg](https://web.archive.org/web/2020id_/https://izhcombank.ru/images/logo-general.svg). Standalone bank mark as an original self-contained SVG \(20x21, single path, fill #4A90E2\): blue circle with the И-swoosh emblem, no lettering. Official site asset from the final brand period \(capture 2020-06-14\). Rendered locally via rsvg-convert and visually confirmed as the standalone emblem. (independence group: official-site-archived).
- Independent evidence: All primary observations derive from one publication domain \(the bank's official site, archived\); the rebranding page, homepage header and asset files are distinct official pages of that one source, and the Wayback Machine provides the dated capture. No independent third-party source was additionally consulted for the mark's design..
- Identity: confirmed — Asset comes from the bank's own domain \(izhcombank.ru\) as archived by the Wayback Machine; the same И-swoosh mark appears in the site header inline logo and in the full wordmark logo data\_logo.svg from the same domain..
- Currency: confirmed — Capture dates \(2020-06-14 asset; 2020 homepage; 2020-08-06 rebranding page\) fall within the bank's last brand period \(Ижкомбанк rebranded to «Датабанк» in 2019, bank closed 2019-2020\); the record title «Датабанк» matches this period. No later official presentation exists..
- Variant: confirmed — Standalone mark variant \(blue circle + emblem, no lettering\) is the site's own icon-size asset \(logo-general.svg, 'logo-general@1x'\); the blue #4A90E2 differs from the header wordmark blue #004790 — both are official same-period variants; suitability decision belongs to candidate preparation..

Rationale: First addition of the bank's own standalone mark: the official logo-general.svg from izhcombank.ru \(Wayback capture 2020-06-14\), the final brand period of the record \(Ижкомбанк rebranded to «Датабанк» in 2019; bank closed 2019-2020\). The mark is a self-contained original-vector emblem — blue #4A90E2 circle with a transparent swoosh-shaped counter — with no accompanying lettering, matching the record title «Датабанк» period. It fits a square cell and remains legible on both themes..
Role: Standalone bank emblem \(site icon-size asset 'logo-general@1x'\); the mark itself, not a full lockup.; variant: Blue standalone circle variant from the bank's own site; the header wordmark used #004790 and the popup lockup a grey #CCCCCC monochrome — this blue circle asset is the site's own standalone variant from the same period..
Visible difference: First addition: the frozen base has no icon.svg for this record \(confirmed absent\), so the visible difference is absence to a real, legible official mark..
Details: All source contours survive: circle boundary, the two swoosh strokes, the small detached tail detail at right, and the transparent counter. The transparent hole correctly shows white/#121212 through the final render. No clipping, no lost details.. Proportions: The near-square 20x21 emblem fills the catalog 162px icon area with comfortable margins on the 240px canvas; it is recognizable at 24/32/48 px diagnostics on both themes, with adequate stroke weight and contrast. No stretching; no circle mask needed since the emblem is already circular..

Source-to-final transformations:
- No geometric transformation: the emblem is used as-is in its 20x21 viewBox; only uniform authoring serialization changed.
- SVGO 4.1.0 with the repository svgo.config.mjs \(config sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e\): 1953 bytes working -\> 1014 bytes optimized \(sha256 479705866ab361c9b017a01b2b1e95066e12acac662e01563cae9ee082ae68d0\); selected because it is smaller, visually faithful \(rsvg-convert comparison max channel difference \<= 8/255 on both themes, antialiasing only\), and converter-compatible in the pinned Desktop export.
- No backing added: the source is a suitable transparent standalone mark \(transparent corners only; the swoosh counter is an intentional transparent hole showing the theme background\), so transparency is preserved per the background/fit policy.

### Light and dark first icon addition

![First icon addition — light background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/1dc8665bd3ad900f439d23e2cac61610fc36318b/review-materials/4475/comparison-light.png?raw=true)

![First icon addition — dark background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/1dc8665bd3ad900f439d23e2cac61610fc36318b/review-materials/4475/comparison-dark.png?raw=true)

### Render checks and limits

Desktop renderer recorded: `offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource` at `2026-10-02T18:05:05.743942791Z`. First addition: the bank has no icon.svg at the frozen base commit \(confirmed pinned-path absence\), so there is no base icon and no base/final pair by contract; the difference is absence to a real, legible official mark. Final render quality: the exact offscreen Desktop frames on both themes \(240x240 px on #FFFFFF and #121212\) show a complete, centered, recognizable blue circular mark; the transparent counter picks up the theme background as designed and legibility is good on both.

- android-compose: not-tested (available: false) — No Android emulator binary or system image is installed in the local Android SDK \(only build tools, cmdline tools, platforms and platform tools\); no AVD can be created from installed images. Skipped with disclosed risk: the Desktop VectorDrawable conversion succeeded, but real Android rendering was not observed..
- android-native: not-tested (available: false) — Same missing emulator/system-image prerequisite as android-compose; the headless Android check is not possible in this environment..
- ios-compose: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS toolchain/runtime exists on this Linux host; unavailable target..
- ios-native: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS toolchain/runtime exists on this Linux host; unavailable target..

Desktop observation is for the generated XML through Compose Desktop `painterResource`, not a claim of successful Android/iOS or native-widget rendering. Unavailable targets remain untested; reviewer visual approval and merge remain separate decisions.

sources.text: Сделать однотипно для светлой и темной темы

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector (self-contained single-path SVG, fill #4A90E2, viewBox 0 0 20 21) of the standalone bank emblem, no accompanying text, from the bank's official site as archived 2020-06-14 (Wayback replay https://web.archive.org/web/20200614234134id_/https://izhcombank.ru/images/logo-general.svg); body sha256 79b98e962fc41940567500bfea8a0fa4e1494b73b415f7437c0e38331b2df68d.

sources.observation: Official site unreachable: HTTPS transfer failed (connection error), consistent with the bank's closure (license revoked 2019).

Archived homepage (2020-01-01): header logo is an inline SVG (viewBox 0 0 207.98 48, colors #004790/#7c7d7d/#9e9fa0) combining the mark with the wordmark; no standalone logo file referenced. source-material extraction blocked: external SVG style context / duplicate vector IDs.
Official rebranding page (archived 2020-08-06): announces ПАО «Ижкомбанк» rebranding to «Датабанк», confirming the record's title/brand period.

Wayback CDX index of site assets; located original SVG assets: images/logo-general.svg (20200614232237), images/popup/data_logo.svg (20200306073005), images/popup/izhkom_logo.svg (20200306073013, replay 404), images/logo.svg (20180214113639, pre-rebrand full logo).

Official full logo SVG (250x55, grey #CCCCCC monochrome variant): circular И-swoosh mark + «ижкомбанк» wordmark. Original vector, but contains accompanying lettering; not suitable as a standalone catalog mark.

Standalone bank mark as an original self-contained SVG (20x21, single path, fill #4A90E2): blue circle with the И-swoosh emblem, no lettering. Official site asset from the final brand period (capture 2020-06-14). Rendered locally via rsvg-convert and visually confirmed as the standalone emblem.

currency.basis: The original SVG is actively linked by the currently served official Databank homepage and matches current compact Databank branding; the legal-details page describes the current entity. Not inferred from an archive date.

identity.basis: Current title Датабанк and official legal history connect the renamed same bank (registration 646) to the old Ижкомбанк metadata. No parent/successor or metadata substitution.

assessment.independenceRationale: Homepage, original SVG and legal-details page are one official publisher, not three independent sources. Their claims are separate: present use/asset, original artwork, and identity continuity. No contradictory independent lifecycle claim is assumed.

variant.basis: Complete compact pure two-line wordmark, with no separate accompanying name or tagline. Original navy #1D478C and near-white #FEFEFE, all letter contours/counters, and original branded asymmetrical tile contour retained. No field/color invention, hole fill, crop, or palette editing. Full and actual 24/32 px independent raster references show recognizable readable lettering on both themes; Desktop verification remains parent-owned.

candidate.detailsJudgement: The full original librsvg source reference and both source/final pairs show all eight letters intact: дата above банк. The д aperture and feet, all three а counters, the б bowl/counter and upper stroke, т crossbar, н bridge and к diagonals survive in the actual Desktop final. Generated XML retains the two original solid paints and counter subpaths; no missing stroke, filled counter, theme-colored hole or cropped letter is visible. The original asymmetric tile contour is preserved. Emblem fidelity and backing fidelity both pass; this is not merely a successful conversion claim.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: The 120x120 source proportions, line spacing, letter spacing and placement remain unchanged in the full final frames. The complete wordmark has clear space on all sides, with no stretching, clipping or extra shrink-to-circle margins. Keeping the source-authored shaped tile preserves its visible silhouette rather than changing it for catalog uniformity. Bound Desktop icon-canvas diagnostics at 24, 32 and 48px on both themes retain separate letters and open navy counters; at 24px the small text is antialiased but дата/банк remains readable, while 32px and 48px are clearer. Optical weight and internal contrast are consistent across themes.
candidate.rationale: First icon addition for Company.id 4475 using the complete compact wordmark currently linked by the official Databank homepage. The official legal-details page connects current AO Databank, registration 646, to the same renamed Izhcombank entity; this is not a parent, successor or historical-purpose substitution. The fresh candidate gives the same navy-backed, near-white lettering on light and dark themes, addressing the saved consistency request without recoloring or repairing the rejected old emblem. No metadata change or precise logo-transition claim is made.
candidate.role: Complete compact pure two-line Cyrillic wordmark, дата/банк, supplied as the official site's SVG favicon artwork. The lettering is the entire mark, not a separate accompanying bank-name label or tagline; this is not a claim that it is an official mobile app icon.
transforms: No geometry, viewport, color, alpha, emblem-placement, or backing changes; complete original source kept.

Installed SVGO 4.1.0 with frozen config f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e produced 2561 bytes from 3197 bytes. Optimized hash 1164f98e1e79addb2f2a1e7a2ad7f0de5e977746ec496c1b1015211be9e16c5b selected after independent working/optimized raster inspection.
candidate.variant: Current original #1D478C navy tile with #FEFEFE lettering. Its authored contour has rounded top-left, top-right and bottom-right corners and a sharp bottom-left corner. The complete source-authored backing and wordmark are retained, with transparency only outside the shaped tile; no circle, invented field or alpha-hole fill is introduced.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: The frozen base has no icon.svg for this record, so this is an absence-to-real-current-icon first addition. Both exact final-only Desktop theme frames show the complete current wordmark. The rejected proposal is not an accepted baseline, and no blank before panel or invented baseline improvement is asserted.

proposals.reason: Fresh current Databank original compact two-line wordmark replaces the rejected archived Izhcombank circular-emblem choice. The current official site serves a fixed navy tile with near-white lettering, making the complete lettering and interior colors identical on light and dark backgrounds. The bank is currently serving customers as AO Databank, registration 646; prior claims of a 2019–2020 closure are not supported and are not reused. Metadata is preserved.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Supported replacement for the current record: exact current official compact wordmark with fixed original backing and complete readable two-row letters. Unlike the rejected Izhcombank transparent counter, the original lettering/counters retain the same contrast on both backgrounds. Preserve the meaningful original tile silhouette rather than force a circle.

sources.observation: Metadata domain retrieval failed with TLS unrecognized-name error. This is an access failure, not a lifecycle or closure finding.

Current homepage titled Датабанк для частных лиц, банковские услуги links /images/favicon.svg as SVG favicon. The downloaded original SVG is a complete compact two-line дата/банк white-on-navy wordmark tile with a deliberately sharp bottom-left corner, not the old blue Izhcombank emblem. Native favicon role does not by itself prove suitability; independent full and 24/32/48 px librsvg views were also inspected.

The current official legal-details page identifies Акционерное общество «Датабанк», abbreviated АО «Датабанк», registration 646. Its history states that the 29.10.2019 shareholder decision renamed АКБ «Ижкомбанк» (ПАО) to АО «Датабанк» and removed public-company designation. It identifies databank.ru as its official registered site and describes present banking supervision. This establishes continuity to record 4475, whose title is Датабанк and fullTitle/domain retain the old Izhcombank references; it does not support the old attempt's closure story.

coverage.basis: For the saved request to make light and dark presentation consistent, the exact fresh Desktop frames show the same complete near-white дата/банк lettering on the same navy tile. All counters reveal the opaque original navy backing, not the surrounding theme, and no letter changes paint or disappears between themes. Only the transparent exterior around the authored rounded corners changes with the background.

Inspected both source/final pairs and 24/32/48px diagnostics of the actual bound Desktop icon canvas on both themes. The two rows keep the same scale, spacing, solid foreground/backing and asymmetric silhouette; every letter and its counters remain present and readable. Theme consistency is achieved by retaining the current source's real backing, not by filling the old emblem's transparent counter or clipping the new wordmark.

The saved rationale asks for consistency without prescribing a color or backing design. The newly retrieved, currently linked official original vector supplies the navy/near-white compact wordmark and its shaped backing together. Final SVG and generated XML preserve those paints and complete letter geometry, and the actual light/dark final frames show matching interior presentation. No arbitrary recoloring, circle normalization or historical-purpose change is used to satisfy the request.
